content: <1>Grace period: {{fromDate}} – {{byDate}} ({{delayDaysCount}} days remaining).</1> During this time, admins can't create rooms, AI agents, or add users. After {{byDate}}, {{productName}} will be unavailable until payment is made.

comment.text: Informational text in the payment container shown when a subscription enters its grace period. It includes the date range ({{fromDate}} – {{byDate}}), remaining days ({{delayDaysCount}}), and the product name ({{productName}}).
